related.title: CycloneDX：服務與元件識別的差異比對
related.titleEn: CycloneDX: component and service inventory diffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付關係圖、3條壞引用的修復證據、孤立節點表及完整性檢查輸出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the relationship graph, evidence for three repaired references, isolated-node list and integrity-check output.
related.difference: 以元件身分與版本建集合，區分升級、新增、移除與服務端點變更，保留序號及產生時間。
related.differenceEn: Form identity-version sets and separate upgrades, additions, removals and service-endpoint changes while retaining serial and creation time.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 圖完整性=端點均可解析的關係數/全部關係；欄位存在不保證內容真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成SBOM有25個元件與30條關係，3條引用不存在的元件。 可解析關係27/30=90%。
Jaccard相似度=交集/聯集；它衡量盤點重疊，不代表安全程度或BOM完整性。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 版本A有24個元件，B有26個，共20個身分版本配對相同。 聯集24+26−20=30；相似度20/30=66.6667%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Graph integrity is resolvable relationships divided by all relationships; populated fields do not prove truthful content. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic SBOM contains twenty-five components and thirty relationships; three reference absent components. Resolvable relationship fraction=27/30=90%.

Jaccard similarity equals intersection over union; it measures inventory overlap, not security or BOM completeness. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Version A has twenty-four components and B twenty-six; twenty identity-version pairs are shared. The union is 24+26−20=30, giving similarity 20/30=66.6667%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Gitleaks：假密鑰樣本與洩漏處置證據
related.titleEn: Gitleaks: fake-secret fixtures and response evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付關係圖、3條壞引用的修復證據、孤立節點表及完整性檢查輸出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the relationship graph, evidence for three repaired references, isolated-node list and integrity-check output.
related.difference: 區分偵測、確認、撤銷與清理；建立不輸出完整字串的報告及最小範圍例外。
related.differenceEn: Separate detection, confirmation, revocation and cleanup; produce redacted reports with narrowly scoped exceptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 圖完整性=端點均可解析的關係數/全部關係；欄位存在不保證內容真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成SBOM有25個元件與30條關係，3條引用不存在的元件。 可解析關係27/30=90%。
處置完成率以已確認需處置項為分母；刪除檔案不等於已撤銷憑證。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成掃描有15筆發現，5筆為核准測試字串，10筆假設需處置；其中7筆有撤銷與驗證證據。 處置完成率7/10=70%，不能用7/15評估此佇列。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Graph integrity is resolvable relationships divided by all relationships; populated fields do not prove truthful content. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic SBOM contains twenty-five components and thirty relationships; three reference absent components. Resolvable relationship fraction=27/30=90%.

Response completion uses confirmed actionable findings as its denominator; deleting a file does not revoke a credential. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic scan has fifteen findings, five approved test strings and ten hypothetically actionable cases; seven have revocation and verification evidence. Completion rate=7/10=70%, not 7/15 for this queue.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
